messages:
Maria Chen: Quick drop — I sketched a compact 'shadow heat-run' protocol we can run during onboarding to warm model caches, surface early quality/renewal signals, and capture feedback without affecting prod quotas. TL;DR: low-rate shadow traffic for 48h -> telemetry tags -> early churn indicators -> handoff checklist.
Anya Patel: love the idea. can you paste the steps? short and ops-friendly pls.
Maria Chen: Sure. Steps (short): 1) create shadow tenant (read-only) 2) enable 0.5–2 qps synthetic pulses for first 48h 3) tag responses with cs:onboard and signal:shadow 4) collect latency, token-cost, top-k conf scores 5) run daily preflight check and flag renewal-risk if conf drops >12% over baseline 6) capture customer feedback microform at 24h and 48h.
Dan Li: How do we generate pulses safely without tripping rate limits or costing too much?
Maria Chen: We use a low-cost prompt set (5 prompts) + compact responses. Example curl to enqueue a shadow pulse via our internal lambda:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/shadow/enqueue"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SHADOW_KEY}"
  -d '{"tenant":"acct-XXXX-shadow","prompt_set":"onboard-miniset","rate":"1r/s","tags":["cs:onboard","signal:shadow"]}'
```

That endpoint is throttled and billed to a separate shadow budget.
Liam O'Neill: From SRE side — ensure KV cache prefixing uses the tenant tag so we don't collide with prod cached prefixes. Also add circuit-breaker: stop pulses if 5xx rate > 1% for 5m.
Dan Li: Agree. Also: include a lightweight sampler of generated text for quality monitoring (not full logs). store hashes+conf only.
Jordan (PM): For renewal signals — what metrics do we surface to CSMs? want something digestible.
Maria Chen: Short list for CSM dashboard: 1) Shadow latency p50/p95 2) Token cost delta vs baseline 3) Avg top-3 confidence 4) % of prompts with hallucination heuristics triggered 5) Feedback sentiment score (microform). If top-3 confidence drops >12% OR sentiment < 0.2 => flag as "early-risk".
Anya Patel: Can we get auto-notifications to teammates? e.g., create a ticket in Zendesk or ping #cs-escalations with context.
Liam O'Neill: Yes — we can wire an alert: if flagged => POST to /hooks/cs-alerts with json {tenant, metric, snapshot_url}. Keep payload minimal.
Maria Chen: DraftRunner note: include a one-click checklist for CSMs during handoff: "Confirm shadow run enabled" / "Review daily snapshot" / "Send 24h feedback form" / "Schedule 7-day check-in".
Dan Li: Small UX ask: make the 24h microform optional per customer. some want no extra pings.
Maria Chen: Noted — add opt-out flag at tenancy creation: opt_out_feedback=true.
Jordan (PM): This feels usable. Can we ship an MVP runbook to docs and a short template for Solutions Engs to use with customers?
Maria Chen: Yes — I'll post a one-page runbook and a ready-to-send email template for SEs by EOD Friday.
deploy-bot: deploy started for service shadow-enqueue v1.3 -> success (build #4812). :white_check_mark:
Anya Patel: Thanks — I'll pilot this with two low-risk accounts next week and report results in Monday's sync.
Maria Chen: Awesome. If anyone wants edit rights to the doc, @Maria Chen — I can share. :sparkles:
Dan Li: I'll add the circuit-breaker and minimal sampler this afternoon.
Liam O'Neill: I'll add the alert webhook and token scoping rules.
Maria Chen: Final ask — please keep messages short in the runbook and include explicit opt-out language for customers. I'll capture feedback after the pilot. :pray:
